evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Keyword-matching benchmarks can credit small models for tool use they never perform.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: A 661.6M parameter model (approx. 65% code/technical text; no dedicated SFT) and a 1,109M model (web-heavy multi-phase curriculum; 6B-token tool-SFT) share decoder, tokenizer, and special tokens, scoring almost identically on lenient tool-use metrics (B4: 0.660 vs. 0.650).

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Verbatim-reproduction checks on training examples separate them completely: the 600M emits valid tool calls with generalized arguments on 6/6 examples; the 1B does so on 0/6 across checkpoints.
